data.title: 贞德[Alter] · 邪龙黑旗·烈焰废墟上的傲慢冷笑
data.description: 【贞德[Alter] · 烈焰废墟·邪龙黑旗与傲慢冷笑】燃烧着无尽红莲业火的焦黑废墟之上，身披黑铁铠甲的复仇者高高立起漆黑的邪龙军旗。黑贞反手握着被火光灼热的诅咒之剑，嘴角勾起傲慢而狂暴的冷笑——「哈哈哈哈！愚蠢的杂碎们，在龙之魔女的业火中化作灰烬吧！御主，好好看着我为你烧尽一切阻碍的姿态！」
data.promptProse: Jeanne Alter steadies the dragon banner planted in broken stones with one armored hand, holding her cursed sword low in a reversed grip with the other. Her purple cape lifts behind black spiked armor as she smiles fiercely across the ruins. The low full-body view includes banner base, boots and complete sword. Rising flames illuminate silver hair and golden eyes, casting jagged rubble shadows while sparks cross the flag's edge.
data.location: 法兰西百年战争燃烧废墟
data.action: 一手稳住已插入碎石地面的邪龙旗，另一手反握诅咒之剑低垂在身侧
data.lighting: 冲天烈火与飞扬火星构筑的剧烈火光，将黑铠与苍白面庞映照得极具戏剧张力
data.camera: full-body low-angle shot, planted banner and lowered sword visible
